fieldDescription: Renewed: this mod's effects (ten skills reworked, four kept from the first Peerless Skills mod). Original: the effects of the first Peerless Skills mod for all fourteen skills. Takes effect in the next battle.
Earn Peerless skill points from experience past the level cap instead of from achievements. Without Achievements - Renewed installed, experience is always used.
How many full experience bars past the level cap make one Peerless skill point. One bar is the experience of one level at the cap.
Multiplies every Peerless skill point earned, from achievements and from experience. 1 is normal, 2 doubles, 0.5 halves. Fractions add up until they make a whole point.
Shows a message when you earn a Peerless skill point.
